jobs.title: VP, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As Vice President of Product Marketing
, you’ll lead the global Product Marketing function and translate the value of our platform and multiple products into compelling narratives and go‑to‑market (GTM) strategies in order to build Via’s reputation and drive growth. This is a great opportunity to make the technology behind public transit transformation exciting and tangible for our key buying audiences. The role is both strategic and hands-on - creating excitement for Via’s product story and bringing it to life in ways that are clear, compelling, and differentiated.

You will partner with product, engineering, sales, the broader marketing team and other Via functions to understand the intricacies of the Via business, and ensure our value propositions resonate with our key audiences. The role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer, and is based in our New York headquarters.

What You'll Do:

Craft Via’s product narrative by creating clear, differentiated, and exciting messaging and positioning across our portfolio of products (Remix, Via, and Citymapper).
Partner with Product leadership to align roadmaps with customer needs and market trends while ensuring all go-to-market plans are grounded in deep product understanding.
Lead product launches that inspire customers and drive growth, including narrative development and execution across key touchpoints.
Enable GTM teams to win by delivering messaging, playbooks, and demos that improve close rates, win rates, and deal velocity.
Collaborate with Communications to create narratives and messages that influence Via’s media coverage, analyst reports, and market perception.
Collaborate on content strategy to deliver high-impact materials that engage buyers from awareness through decision.
Advance thought leadership by creating compelling content and engaging in speaking opportunities that reinforce Via’s position as the category leader.
Establish and track OKRs and KPIs for team performance, launch outcomes, and GTM effectiveness, using those insights to continuously improve.
Create replicable tools and processes to support efficiency and scale.

Who You Are:

Minimum of 13 years of Product Marketing experience in B2B or B2G environments, with a proven record of creating differentiated positioning and driving measurable business impact.
Strong strategic thinking paired with executional excellence — you can shape a vision and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Product, and other cross functional leaders to align strategies and outcomes.
A customer-first mindset and passion for creating market-defining stories that inspire and sell.
An ability to create measurable impact - and then build systems and processes to replicate success.
Deep curiosity about how the product works, the role it plays in solving customer pain points, and what makes it truly unique.
A sense of urgency, extreme ownership, and a bias for action, staying hands-on to do whatever it takes to drive impact.
Creative, resourceful, and energized by a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Compensation and Benefits:

Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.
Salary Range: $230,000–$270,000
We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of world-class engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

About this role:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Remix platform itself — its usability, scalability, and flexibility — ensuring Remix remains the most powerful and intuitive tool available to transit professionals globally.

This role sits at the center of everything Remix does. You will own the platform foundation that every module is built on, champion AI-led insights that help agencies design better service and measure real performance, and maintain the end-to-end view from planning through operations and back — ensuring data flows in ways that make each step smarter than the last. You are equally comfortable setting long-term platform direction and rolling up your sleeves to sharpen individual features and make each module best in class.

What you'll do:

Own the Remix platform roadmap — usability, scalability, flexibility, and the cross-cutting capabilities that every module depends on
Define and drive the vision for AI-led insights within Remix, enabling transit agencies to make data-informed decisions about service design, network performance, and operational efficiency
Hold the end-to-end product view: from network planning through scheduling and live operations, and back into planning via performance data — ensuring the platform is a continuous feedback loop, not a collection of disconnected tools
Identify and prioritize vertical feature investments across Remix modules, with the rigor to make each one best in class rather than broadly adequate
Partner with engineering and design to raise the bar on platform usability — reducing friction for planners, schedulers, and analysts without sacrificing the depth power users depend on
Work closely with data science and engineering to define how AI and analytics capabilities are surfaced in the product — what insights matter, when they appear, and how they drive action
Engage directly with customers to understand workflow pain points, validate priorities, and pressure-test the roadmap against real operational needs
Stay current on industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technology to ensure Remix leads rather than follows

Who you are:

You have 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platform or infrastructure-layer products used in complex enterprise workflows
You are a big-picture thinker who can articulate a multi-year platform vision while also making sharp, well-reasoned prioritization calls at the feature level
You have strong instincts for usability and product quality — you notice when something is harder than it needs to be, and you know how to fix it without breaking what works

You can quickly become technically fluent in the underlying data models and entities that power planning and scheduling systems, and you are a credible voice in technical architecture decisions alongside your engineering partners — capable of evaluating tradeoffs and advocating for platform choices that serve both current needs and long-term scalability
You have a track record of shipping high-quality features in complex, workflow-heavy enterprise environments where precision and reliability matter
You are collaborative, direct, and effective at building alignment across engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market partners

jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About ZAP Solutions ZAP Solutions is the market leader in admissions and enrollment management software for medical, health professions, graduate, and undergraduate programs. Our flagship AMP platform, along with our CRM, SAMS, and Schedule Today modules, is trusted by more than 175 higher education programs across the US, Canada, and Australia to run applicant recruitment, review, interview scheduling, and matriculation. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, ZAP was acquired by Banyan Software and is entering a new phase focused on platform modernization, AI-enabled workflows, and expansion of its customer base.
The Opportunity ZAP is at an inflection point. The company has built a durable market position on the strength of deep client relationships and customization, but that model now needs to evolve into a modern, scalable SaaS platform capable of doubling the customer base without doubling the codebase. The engineering organization has operated without a formal leadership layer for years, and there is no formal product management function. The incoming CPTO will unify product direction and technology execution under a single accountable seat, bring structure and product management maturity to a team of experienced developers, and establish an AI-first operating rhythm.
You will join ZAP Solutions directly as a core member of the leadership team, reporting to the CEO. You will set product direction, own the technical foundation, shape culture, and drive transformation with your own hands on the work. The platform has to be reliable, the data has to be an asset, and the opportunity to create competitive distance through AI is real.
What You Will OwnProduct Direction and Discipline Own product direction as the synthesis of customer signals, usage data, and market insights, moving the roadmap from customer-reactive to market-facing.
Run product discovery personally: focus groups, customer advisory councils, spec creation, and validation, particularly during year one while a product function is being built.
Establish formal prioritization, roadmap, and release planning practices, communicated internally and to customers.
Partner closely with the VP of Client Success, who holds the deep customer relationships today, to build a product operating model that plays to both strengths.
Lend the product voice to enterprise sales cycles and Customer Success partnership.

Technology and Architecture Define and execute the technical vision for the AMP platform and companion products (CRM, SAMS, Schedule Today), ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and built for the next phase of growth.
Drive consolidation of the multi-codebase legacy footprint toward a modern, maintainable SaaS architecture that preserves ZAP's reputation for client responsiveness while lifting the cost of customization.
Design a data architecture that serves analytics, BI, and AI as a unified estate, positioning ZAP for AI capabilities generic models cannot replicate on applicant and enrollment data.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted development practices across the engineering team, moving from ad hoc use of tools like Claude Code and Cursor to a systematic capability that improves throughput.
Own security, compliance, and data privacy practices appropriate for a higher education SaaS environment, including FERPA, PCI-DSS, and WCAG/Section 508 accessibility standards.
Manage technical debt pragmatically, balancing remediation with forward momentum on the roadmap.

Leadership and Culture Build and lead a high-performing engineering team of 10 to 15, identifying and developing internal team leads, and creating the first formal management layer this organization has had.
Establish engineering and product-ops practices that scale without bureaucracy, moving the team from reactive work assignment to a proactive roadmap.
Calibrate change to team tenure and mission-criticality. ZAP's developers have been in seat for years, and the transformation has to bring them along.
Invest in reskilling the team for AI-native ways of working.
Address underperformance directly and quickly, without waiting for HR.

Executive Partnership Serve as the CEO's primary product and technology partner on business direction, market positioning, and investment decisions.
Identify where AI and platform capabilities can reshape market position and create durable competitive advantage.
Represent the product and technology vision with conviction in executive, customer, and board conversations.
Push back constructively on decisions that trade short-term velocity for long-term product or platform health.

What We Are Looking For The Future Forward CPTO is a proven SaaS leader who unifies product vision and technology execution under a single accountable seat, and is comfortable leading through modernization and platform inflection. This is not a traditional CTO or CPO role. It demands someone who holds deep product thinking and technical delivery in equal measure, leads with an AI-first methodology, and is energized by transformation rather than threatened by it. They are close enough to the product and code to stay personally connected, and mature enough to modernize a legacy platform without disrupting the customers and long-tenured teams who depend on it. They choose this environment because it offers something bigger organizations cannot: the ability to set product direction, own the technical foundation, shape culture, and drive transformation with their own hands on the work.
Must-Haves Led a technology and product transformation in tandem, with specific delivery and adoption outcomes, and brought the team through the change rather than around it.
Shipped AI-embedded product capabilities with measurable outcomes, or led sustained AI experimentation with clear conviction about where it creates durable value. Personal, daily agentic AI use, not talking about it at a distance.
Owned product direction as the synthesis of customer signals, usage data, and market insights, and can point to a roadmap they moved from customer-reactive to market-facing.
Owned a SaaS platform's security posture and compliance requirements (SOC 2, industry-specific standards) personally, not through a delegated security team.
Designed or redesigned a data architecture that serves analytics, BI, and AI as a unified asset.
Built and scaled an engineering team, including hiring, developing engineers into leaders, and managing performance directly. Addressed underperformance directly, not through HR.
Made architecture and product investment decisions with direct commercial rationale tied to retention, revenue, or competitive moat, and can make an investment case a CFO would accept.

Bonus Points Experience in EdTech, higher education technology, admissions or enrollment management, CRM ecosystems, or comparable vertical SaaS with heavy customization patterns.
Familiarity with centralized application services (AMCAS, CASPA, PharmCAS) or SIS/CRM integrations common in higher education.
Background operating in an AWS-primary infrastructure environment with regulated data (FERPA or comparable).
Track record consolidating a multi-codebase or heavily forked platform into a maintainable SaaS product without breaking client trust.

64 percent of US medical schools run their admissions on AMP. Over 6 million applications processed through the platform. 175+ higher education programs across the US, Canada, and Australia. 95 percent customer satisfaction. 99 percent AWS uptime. jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases.
You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Sr Director, Product Development Lead is entrusted with owning and leading the global development of late-stage radiopharmaceutical compounds for therapeutic oncology indications. This role provides cross-functional leadership across clinical, regulatory, CMC, quality, manufacturing/supply chain, and commercial, and drives governance, decision-making, and risk management to deliver program milestones and support regulatory interactions and approvals. This role may include direct people management of one or more Project managers. As a strategic thinker and clear communicator, the role requires a hands-on approach to aligning stakeholders, maintaining an execution-ready integrated plan, and presenting program status, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Key Accountabilities

Development Leadership: Lead the Global Program Leadership Team (GPLT) and hold accountability for cross-functional commitments across CMC, Clinical, and Regulatory. Set and communicate GPLT program objectives in alignment with the Tx BU objective cascade model, ensuring clarity on shared program outcomes vs. functional objectives. Develop and maintain the Global Development Plan (GDP) and Target Product Profile (TPP), ensuring these remain current and drive aligned decision-making across the matrix team.
Strategic Direction: Showcase courage in strategic thinking, guiding matrixed teams through complex decision-making and risk management processes.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Foster a collaborative spirit, working seamlessly with teams spanning clinical, non-clinical, regulatory affairs, quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial, medical affairs and program management to formulate plans that achieve program milestones and objectives.
Program Governance & Change Management: Drive integrated cross-functional planning and confirm readiness for key milestones and inflection points; ensure scope, timeline, and budget impacts are assessed and elevated appropriately for leadership review (e.g., Product Management Committee) and that decisions are documented and communicated.
Risk Ownership & Communication: Identify, assign ownership of, and actively manage program risks/issues; communicate risks, mitigations, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
Budget Planning & Forecasting: Lead program-level budget planning and forecasting in partnership with Finance and functional leads; monitor spend vs. plan, surface variances, and drive timely re-forecasting and trade-off recommendations to support portfolio decisions.
Regulatory Pathway Design: Partner with Clinical and Regulatory Affairs to craft the ideal development pathway for approval, aiming to meet product attributes and commercial objectives.
Regulatory Interactions & Communication Alignment: Lead cross-functional preparation for key health authority interactions (e.g., FDA Type B), ensuring consistent internal communication, clear objectives, aligned messaging, and timely delivery of high-quality briefing materials and responses.
Executive-Ready Program Reporting: Maintain clear, decision-focused reporting (dashboards, milestone tracking, red/amber/green risks) and ensure critical risks are visible to appropriate leadership teams with recommended actions and owners.
Development Planning: Create and execute comprehensive product development plans and data packages, paving the way for informed go/no-go decisions and continuous progression towards product approval.
CMC/Supply & Vendor (CDMO) Alignment: Partner with Technical Operations, Quality, and external vendors to ensure manufacturing readiness, GMP compliance, and supply continuity; proactively identify constraints and develop mitigation plans that protect clinical execution and regulatory commitments.
Stakeholder Engagement: Engage subject matter experts and thought leaders, both within and outside the organization, fostering rich scientific dialogue, extracting insights, and refining development plans and strategies.
Global Study Execution & Enrollment Enablement: Collaborate with Clinical Operations and regional teams to anticipate recruitment risks (including competing trials), support site activation strategy, and drive actions that protect enrollment and global data consistency.
Inclusive Leadership & Communication: Foster an inclusive, respectful team culture, including use of inclusive language in communications and reinforcement of constructive cross-functional collaboration.

Education And Experience

Master’s or PhD in medical, pharma or biotech field strongly preferred; 12+ years in pharma/biotech required.
Minimum of 5+ years leading cross-functional product teams within the pharma/biotech domain.
Prior experience in oncology development and/or radiopharmaceuticals will be a distinct advantage.
Experience in clinical Phase 2, Phase 3 and through approval required, specifically in the therapeutic area assigned.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically, communicate effectively, and collaborate in a matrixed team environment.
Direct people management experience is considered an advantage.

Key Capabilities

Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected
Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges
Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do
Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results
Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges
Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language
Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals
Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges
Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts
, we strive to be extraordinary
, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity

Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world. We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

Dragos is seeking a principal-level Product Manager to lead the Cloud Platform product team, responsible for replacing the existing Customer Portal and building the unified customer experience at platform.dragos.com, backed by a centralized API layer that serves SaaS users, on-premises deployments, and machine integrations alike. This role owns the vision, roadmap, and execution to unify Dragos's distributed portals and capabilities, including WorldView threat intelligence, Neighborhood Keeper, managed services, AI, documentation, and artifact access, into a single seamless experience across cloud and hybrid on-premises deployments. You will partner closely with engineering leadership, product teams, internal stakeholders, and customers to shape and execute the platform roadmap.

Own the vision, strategy, and quarter-over-quarter roadmap for the Dragos Cloud Platform, replacing the existing Customer Portal with a unified experience that brings every customer-facing capability together under a single login.
Define the platform architecture strategy, including the central API layer, authentication and identity approach, and how the platform consistently serves both SaaS and hybrid on-premises customers.
Lead the integration of Dragos's key product surfaces, including threat intelligence, community defense, managed services, AI, and compliance reporting, into the unified platform experience.
Own artifact delivery, fleet management, and entitlement features, giving customers a single place to download platform updates and content, monitor their on-premises deployments, and manage their product subscriptions.
Drive a coherent customer experience across the SaaS portal and on-premises interfaces, and define proactive service flows that surface the right support and success touchpoints at the right moment.
Partner with feature teams across Dragos to align on integration boundaries, shared platform services, and a consistent API surface.
Engage directly with customers and customer-facing teams to discover and validate use cases, gather feedback, and iterate on product direction.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, make prioritization and trade-off decisions, and communicate requirements to Engineering with clear business rationale.
Define and track product KPIs, including platform adoption, migration progress, and time-to-value for newly integrated capabilities.
Support Sales with competitive insights and customer guidance; shape go-to-market positioning that connects the unified platform to customers' operational continuity and security operations needs.

Qualifications

10+ years of Product Management experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud products, or multi-product unified experiences, ideally in cybersecurity or adjacent technology domains.
Strong understanding of cloud platform and API architecture, including centralized API design serving multiple client types, authentication and identity at scale, and multi-tenant SaaS delivery.
Experience leading platform consolidation or portal replacement, including managing feature migration, driving customer adoption, and maintaining continuity across the transition.
Technical fluency with APIs, data models, and backend workflows, with the ability to partner closely with Engineering and make informed architecture trade-off decisions.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company on a mission to shift the advantage from attackers to defenders. Our flagship product, the NodeZero® platform, autonomously executes real attack techniques in production—safely, without agents or disruption—to help organizations find exploitable weaknesses, fix what matters most, verify remediation, and continuously prove their resilience.

NodeZero helps organizations understand risk across their internal networks, external attack surface, cloud environments, identities, data, and web applications. Customers use the platform to replace assumptions with evidence: what an attacker can actually exploit, how an attack can move through the environment, what the business impact could be, and whether a fix truly worked.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We are committed to solving common security problems including ineffective tools, false positives, alert fatigue, blind spots, checkbox security culture, cybersecurity skills shortages, and the time and expense of point-in-time manual assessments. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls committed to respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote-first company, we require a minimum 25Mbps consumer-grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do
